base: R1 WorkerSpec/envelope/fixtures unchanged; explicit local-only protected guest route, never fallback
scope: One physical Apple Linux ARM guest OMP execution. Host retains model transport authority; guest has no Host HOME, auth database, provider credential, network or general proxy.

runtime.evidence: Actual network-none/read-only UID501 guest Bun/OMP CLI and SDK/native binding startup passed; not model/work acceptance

transport: Descriptor-contained, bounded file spool. Guest-writable request directory and separately Host-owned response directory mounted read-only in guest. Do not multiplex unknown frames onto existing OMP stdin or use a network/credential fallback.

trusted_configuration.response_directory: absolute exact guest read-only mount path
trusted_configuration.max_tokens: positive integer Host-issued cap; initial canary1024
trusted_configuration.allowed_tools: exact Host-issued SDK external tool names

host_configuration: Same binding plus canonical Host directory paths, journal_path, literal-loopback HTTP(S) /v1 endpoint and model pin. Endpoint/model/limits are trusted config, never request fields. Before admission, immediately before model I/O and before release of results, caller's current authority/lease authorization callback must succeed. No allow-by-default authorization.

request.payload_json: original UTF-8 OpenAI request JSON string <=1048576 bytes
request.payload_sha256: SHA256 of exact payload_json UTF-8 bytes

request_validation: Closed outer fields. Payload model exact, stream:true and max_tokens exact cap, messages bounded by payload bytes, tools only allowed names. Reject requested URLs, credentials or unsupported fields. Trusted Host changes only stream=false and removes stream_options for the existing nonstreaming loopback model endpoint; no JSON/tool parser repair.

response.completion_json: exact successful JSON completion text or null, <=4194304 UTF-8 bytes
response.reason_code: bounded allowlisted diagnostic code or null

cancellation.semantics: Guest abort never replays a model request. Host cancels/withholds that exact in-flight request and retains unknown/evidence when completion cannot be confirmed. Lease/epoch change fences late delivery.

durability: Persist original request ID/digest and pending I/O intent before one model invocation. Same ID/same bytes returns original completed/rejected evidence after current authorization; different bytes conflict; crash-window pending remains effect_unknown without a new model invocation. Response files are atomic/no-follow, receipt/blob digests revalidated on replay. Bound total requests/spool and cleanly stop the owned broker.
sdk: Reuse pinned real OMP createAgentSession/RPC bootstrap. Explicit --broker-config selects credentialless guest route and requires real custom provider transport, current exact model and no auth discovery. Missing/invalid broker is fatal, not host subscription fallback. Existing explicitly selected Host scoped route remains distinct until Root's clean physical cutover. Empty tool discovery, no recursive helpers/extensions/prewalk/MCP/global settings, no yolo. Tools registered by supervisor through existing RPC remain Host-authorized; no new ambient SDK tools.
codec: Reuse apps/ghost-omp/completion-codec.mjs validateLocalCompletion and completionToSse extracted by Root from the already exercised Pi provider; do not duplicate or relax the codec.
